name: Imouto ~Sweet & Bitter~
source:
Right in the middle of puberty, there’s love and studying for exams and Valentines.
Every day is busy and you get swept up in some things, and chase after others…
Your unbalanced mind and body exist amidst the bittersweet scent of reality.
Facing various trails you grow towards adulthood...

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=33085]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
正值青春期，有恋爱，有考试复习，也有情人节。
每天忙忙碌碌，时而被一些事推着走，时而又追逐着另一些事……
身心尚未平衡的你，置身于现实苦涩又甘甜的气息中。
面对种种岔路，逐渐走向成年……

[简介译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=33085]Getchu.com[/url]]
